themeHint: “System” follows your device’s light or dark mode.
languageHint: Language of buttons and hints. The language you study is set separately.
textSizeHint: The size of all text in the app: buttons, menus and cards.
retentionHint: Higher means more frequent reviews and less forgetting. Now {percent}%.
limitsHint: No limits by default: the deck can be reviewed until it is empty.
typing: Type the word instead of flipping
autoSpeak: Speak the word automatically when the card turns over
gamificationHint: Rewards, the character and celebrations. Applies right away.

gamificationModes.maxHint: Animations, confetti and a lively character. Bright and fun — great for children.
gamificationModes.mediumHint: Rewards, achievements and the character stay, without animations that make you wait.
gamificationModes.offHint: Just learning: no character and no celebrations.

gradeButtonsOnPhone: Grade buttons under the card on phones
dictionariesHint: The "Find" button next to a word looks up translations and examples in free open sources. Suggestions are only offered — you choose what to keep.

dictionaryRoles.tatoeba: real example sentences in many languages

tourHint: A short tour of the home screen and the pages of the app.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.hint: A notification once 15 words are waiting for review (not sooner than an hour and a half after you leave the app), even with the app closed. Offline, it arrives as soon as the phone is back online.
reminders.unsupported: This browser does not show notifications from websites.
reminders.install: On iPhone reminders come only from the app on the home screen: Share → Add to Home Screen, then turn them on here.
reminders.denied: Notifications are blocked in the browser settings. Allow them for this site to get reminders.
reminders.failed: Could not turn the reminders on. Try again later.

push.title: VocabX
push.waiting: Words waiting for review: {count}. A few minutes, and they stay with you.
push.idle: A few minutes of learning today keeps your streak going.

reminders.unset: Reminders are not set up on the server yet (no push key).

offer.title: Remind you when words are waiting?
offer.text: Great work! Review your words on time so they stay with you — we will tell you when.
offer.note: A notification comes once 15 words are waiting, but not sooner than an hour and a half from now. Turn it off any time in the settings.
offer.failed: Could not turn the reminders on. Try in the settings.
